faq_heading: Chilliwack Proper South houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Chilliwack Proper South sell for?
faq.a: 44 houses sold in Chilliwack Proper South between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $700,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Chilliwack Proper South?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.9% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Chilliwack Proper South sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 44 houses that sold in Chilliwack Proper South went for between $619,750 and $771,250, around a median of $700,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Chilliwack Proper South sell above asking price?
faq.a: 9% of the 44 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.9% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Chilliwack Proper South?
faq.a: The median year built was 1979 for the 44 houses sold in Chilliwack Proper South.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Chilliwack Proper South usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Chilliwack Proper South had 4 bedrooms, from the 44 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Chilliwack Proper South houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

44 houses sold in Chilliwack Proper South with a median price of $700,000 (the middle half sold between $619,750 and $771,250), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 96.9% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $392 per square foot, a median year built of 1979 and a median lot of 6,011 square feet.

blocks.text: How Chilliwack Proper South compares with the rest of Chilliwack

The median house in Chilliwack Proper South sold for $700,000, 15% below the Chilliwack median of $825,000 across 294 sales. Chilliwack Proper South houses took a median 28 days to sell, against 26 days for Chilliwack as a whole.
